description: User-selected nine native favorites, in verified order. Prefer hotkeys elsewhere; Search Files is an explicit exception. This is a portable reference, not a private settings import. Null aliases reflect commands with no saved alias.

favorites.title: Search Files
favorites.behavior: Your explicit favorite exception; also available on Option–1.

favorites.title: Focus: Code: Amp | Slack
favorites.behavior: Amp + Slack main, Zen + Ghostty support; Notion minimized. Confirm 45 minutes; optional 30/25.

favorites.title: Focus: Code: Cursor | Slack
favorites.behavior: Cursor + Slack main, Zen + Ghostty support; Notion minimized. Confirm 45 minutes; optional 30/25.

favorites.title: Focus: Zen Code
favorites.behavior: Zed + Ghostty + Chrome Canary + Notion; confirm 45 minutes; optional 30/25.

favorites.title: Focus: Work Core
favorites.behavior: Edge + Teams + Claude; confirm 45 minutes; optional 30/25.

favorites.title: My Passwords
favorites.behavior: Find a password through the existing 1Password command.

favorites.title: Caffeinate for ...
favorites.behavior: Set separate Hours, Minutes and Seconds arguments. No global hotkey.

favorites.title: Toggle Caffeinate
favorites.behavior: Toggle the existing Coffee awake state. No global hotkey.

favorites.title: Toggle System Appearance
favorites.behavior: Switch system appearance. No global hotkey.
